acceptance_criteria.statement: WriteProposalWorkflow.handle remains the sole application-facing write Interface. Every pre-acquisition Workspace/resource/execution authorization, exact compatibility, complete m4r1 or proposal-expiry denial creates no execution/acquisition/admission/audit-start artifact and zero provider calls. Read/observation authority cannot escalate. A durable before/after oracle proves temporary execution-authority denial preserves exact approved state and approval identity/version/digest, while each material capability, external-scope binding, policy or reference incompatibility atomically projects proposal_state=stale and approval_validity=invalidated with a typed reason; the old approval never becomes reusable and a new proposal plus authorized-human approval is required.

The logical execution ID and canonical-json-v1 complete-intent fingerprint are server-owned, immutable and absent from writable application/HTTP command schemas; attempted injection is rejected before state creation. An independent oracle recomputes the exact fingerprint from authoritative server-normalized operation, capability, scope, protected reference/resource and title/description inputs and compares both identities byte-for-byte at proposal, acquisition, admission, persisted envelope and provider verification boundaries. acquire_execution uses fresh post-lock PostgreSQL time and atomically commits one complete generation-1 AcquireWitness; every identified loser makes zero gateway/provider calls and every pre-commit fault leaves no partial tuple or caller-influenced identity.

A fixed global reference-key plus Workspace dispatch epoch vector serializes all supported authority/selector/key mutation adapters. After acquisition, authorize_and_admit_dispatch locks execution and both epochs, reloads all current facts and fully reverifies exact m4r1 canonical bytes, MAC, claims, trusted-store equality, key identity/status and expiry. Independent post-acquisition corruption/trusted-store/key/authority mutations deny with no admission or provider call.

Fresh post-lock PostgreSQL time and current owner/generation plus unexpired lease/reference atomically commit at most one immutable DispatchAdmissionWitness per logical execution. One private row binds every schema/purpose, Workspace/proposal/logical identity/fingerprint, exact capability/binding/policy/reference and complete-intent digest, authority decision/epoch witness, owner/generation, database times, non-secret signing provenance, opaque routing digest, exact envelope bytes/digest and linked audit field. A deterministic commit/ack-ambiguity fixture captures the exact intended tuple/bytes: authoritative readback returns that one byte-identical complete tuple with no second insert/sign/regeneration if committed, or complete admission/audit absence with no gateway call or #77 retry if rolled back; no partial or third state is valid.

Admission commit is the logical start of the provider write. The exact privately persisted m4-dispatch-admission-v1 envelope is the only create_ticket input. After admission-first, later authority/selector/key mutation or proposal/reference/lease expiry cannot reauthorize, cancel, replace, upgrade or retarget the dispatch; the original byte-identical envelope/intent is sent exactly once. Mutation-first remains denied.

The SQLite reference-provider Adapter verifies envelope integrity and recomputed signed-intent fingerprint before its provider-owned logical-ID ledger. One BEGIN IMMEDIATE commits effect or closed rejection with outcome. Same ID/fingerprint replays; two independently valid test-harness envelopes with the same ID and different self-consistent fingerprints reach ProviderIdempotencyConflict before target lookup/mutation and create no second effect; tampering fails earlier. Separately, each of target_not_found, validation_rejected and policy_rejected atomically persists exactly one ledger outcome with exact logical ID/fingerprint/admission digest, creates zero ticket/target effects, replays identically and survives provider restart; every pre-commit fault leaves neither row nor effect.

Every post-admission crash/session/transport/ack uncertainty remains executing with the same outstanding admission/logical identity/fingerprint and typed indeterminate_external_outcome until Knora finalizes. Admission-before-gateway and pre-SQLite-commit branches have exactly zero provider ledger rows/effects; committed-before-ack has exactly one durable replayable success effect/outcome or one named closed-rejection outcome with zero effects. A read-only provider lookup before receipt yields provider_outcome_not_found without retiring/finalizing admission or granting retry. #77 reloads NoAdmission or AdmissionOutstanding recovery seeds but performs no observation workflow, retry, replay, takeover, first-admission recovery or generation 2+.

record_execution_observation and finalize_execution use fresh post-lock PostgreSQL time and require current generation-1 owner and lease. For delayed success and each closed rejection, fixtures start with the SQLite outcome committed, no PostgreSQL observation and lifecycle executing. After expiry, each operation is fenced and a before/after PostgreSQL snapshot remains identical: no observation row, no observation/audit append and no terminal lifecycle/outcome rewrite; the authoritative SQLite outcome remains readable after provider restart.

Only direct success and target_not_found, validation_rejected or policy_rejected finalize; receipt-possible results remain executing/202 and provider fingerprint conflict remains executing/409 with no retry authority. Every success, closed-rejection, indeterminate, conflict and fenced application/HTTP projection must match a closed discriminated allowlist exactly and recursively exclude raw provider/routing, admission/envelope/MAC/fingerprint, authority epoch/decision/witness, key/signing, credential/secret and every other private admission field. Observation/read authority never constructs write authority or an admission envelope.

A post-restart canonical append-only audit projection exactly reconstructs caller/proposal/approval/execution actors, both current decisions, compatibility, complete acquisition/admission witnesses, authority epochs, database times, provider alias, immutable intent/identity/fingerprint, observations and outcome while excluding raw provider IDs/routing, envelope bytes/MAC, keys, credentials and authority secrets. M1-M3 regressions remain green.

test_cases.statement: At application and HTTP seams, independently deny every pre-acquisition class and Execute with principals proven to have only read/observation authority; capture proposal and approval before/after every denial and separately force material capability, binding, policy and reference incompatibility.
test_cases.oracle: Every branch has no execution/acquisition/admission/audit-start artifact and zero provider calls. Temporary execution-authority denial preserves exact approved state and approval identity/version/digest. Each material mismatch persists exact stale/invalidated state with a typed reason, permanently rejects old-approval reuse and requires a new proposal identity plus new human approval.

test_cases.statement: At application/HTTP seams prove writable command schemas omit logical execution ID and request fingerprint and reject injection before state creation. Independently recompute canonical-json-v1 from authoritative normalized intent and compare both server identities across proposal, acquisition, admission, persisted envelope and provider evidence; then race identified public-workflow contenders and inject faults after each acquisition write before commit.
test_cases.oracle: The recomputed fingerprint and server-minted logical ID are byte-identical and immutable at every boundary and cannot be caller-influenced. One AcquireApplied contender owns one complete atomic tuple and is the only possible gateway caller; every loser has per-contender zero calls. Separate snapshots see no pre-commit partial state; rollback restores approved with no tuple or caller-influenced identity; restart reconstructs every acquisition field.

test_cases.statement: After acquisition and while admission is blocked, independently exercise every real authority/selector mutation and non-runtime m4r1 canonical-byte/MAC/claims corruption, trusted-store delete/replace/mismatch and key revoke/unknown/rotate/unavailable fixture.
test_cases.oracle: Post-lock reload/reverification observes every class, persists no admission, makes zero gateway/provider calls and appends only sanitized pre-provider evidence.

test_cases.statement: Race every real typed mutation Adapter against admission, race same-generation issuers, and block acquisition/admission across proposal/reference/lease expiry under non-database clock skew.
test_cases.oracle: Mutation-first denies or admission-first binds the exact prior vector; one byte-identical admission exists. Fresh post-lock PostgreSQL time decides each expiry and a transaction-start clock cannot revive it.

test_cases.statement: Read the committed admission row/audit in one snapshot, compare every AC-04 field including the independently recomputed server-owned fingerprint and immutable logical ID to authoritative inputs, restart PostgreSQL and rotate the active issuance key. At the commit/ack fault seam capture the exact intended complete tuple/bytes and force committed-but-unacknowledged and rolled-back outcomes.
test_cases.oracle: Committed readback returns exactly the intended tuple, identities and persisted bytes with no second insert/sign/regeneration. Rolled-back readback returns complete admission/audit absence with no gateway call or #77 retry. No partial, caller-influenced or third state is valid.

test_cases.statement: Pause immediately after admission commit; independently mutate/revoke every authority/selector/key class and cross proposal/reference/lease expiry before resuming.
test_cases.oracle: Exactly one gateway call carries the original byte-identical envelope and intent with no reauthorization, cancellation, replacement, upgrade or retarget; later lease expiry may fence only Knora finalization.

test_cases.statement: In private provider contract composition, deliver same-ID/same-fingerprint replay, two independently valid self-consistent same-ID/different-fingerprint envelopes, separate tampered/cross-bound envelopes, and parameterized target_not_found, validation_rejected and policy_rejected requests with pre-commit faults.
test_cases.oracle: Equal fingerprint replays one effect; both valid unequal fingerprints pass integrity and provider recomputation from signed authoritative intent, the normal envelope equals TC-02's independent server recomputation, and the second reaches provider ledger conflict before target lookup with no second effect; tampering fails before SQLite. Each closed rejection commits one exact logical-ID/fingerprint/admission-digest ledger outcome, creates zero target effects, replays identically and survives provider restart; its pre-commit fault leaves neither row nor effect.

test_cases.statement: Fault after admission before gateway, before SQLite commit and after SQLite commit before acknowledgement as three named branches; call only the read-only provider observer in no-receipt branches and independently cover success plus all three closed rejections in committed-before-ack.
test_cases.oracle: The first two branches have exactly zero provider ledger rows and zero ticket/target effects. Committed-before-ack has exactly one durable replayable ledger outcome and exactly one success effect or one named closed rejection with zero effects, unchanged after provider restart. Every not-yet-finalized branch remains executing with the same admission/logical ID/fingerprint and exact indeterminate_external_outcome and grants no #77 retry/replay/takeover; no-receipt lookup returns provider_outcome_not_found.

test_cases.statement: After restart reload executing with no admission and executing with outstanding admission as the two exact ExecutionRecoverySeed variants, then call Execute again.
test_cases.oracle: Execute returns current ExecutionInProgress; #77 performs no provider observation, admission creation/replacement, dispatch/replay, retry authorization, takeover or generation increment in either branch.

test_cases.statement: Separately delay success, target_not_found, validation_rejected and policy_rejected after SQLite commit but before PostgreSQL observation. Cross lease expiry, invoke observation/finalization under deterministic lock barriers, restart/read provider, and cover every success, closed-rejection, indeterminate, conflict and fenced application/HTTP projection.
test_cases.oracle: Each expired operation uses fresh post-lock PostgreSQL time, returns ExecutionFenced and leaves before/after PostgreSQL state identical; provider truth survives restart. For every result variant, the complete application projection and decoded HTTP body equal the exact discriminated allowlist with no extra recursive key and exclude raw provider/routing, admission/envelope/MAC/fingerprint, authority, key/signing, credential/secret and all private admission fields.

test_cases.statement: Restart PostgreSQL and SQLite independently after direct, indeterminate, conflict and no-admission outcomes and reconstruct audit solely from append-only records.
test_cases.oracle: The full AC-10 projection matches proposal/acquisition/admission/provider evidence; provider ledger remains independent and every excluded raw/secret field is absent.

test_cases.statement: Run focused M4.3, full repository pytest, Ruff, Compose and clean Alembic verification on the exact candidate SHA.
test_cases.oracle: All candidate checks and M1-M3 regressions are green.

required_evidence.statement: Rejected caller identity injection, independent canonical fingerprint recomputation, byte-identical server-owned logical ID/fingerprint across proposal/acquisition/admission/envelope/provider, per-contender acquisition results/call counts, pre-commit isolation, rollback absence and exact post-commit/restart AcquireWitness tuple.
Real mutation-adapter epoch traces, complete post-acquisition m4r1 failure matrix and fresh post-lock PostgreSQL expiry samples.

One complete admission-row witness, linked audit, exact persisted envelope bytes, key-rotation reload, admission-first non-cancellation traces, and both authoritative branches of the commit/ack ambiguity fixture with no second insert/sign/regeneration or partial state.

Provider-owned named evidence for target_not_found, validation_rejected and policy_rejected, each binding the exact logical execution ID/fingerprint/admission digest, one closed SQLite ledger outcome, zero ticket/target effects, pre-commit rollback absence, equal-fingerprint replay and the identical authoritative outcome after provider restart; plus the two-valid-envelope conflict and tamper rejection.

Three branch-specific post-admission provider/Knora state records proving exact zero/zero before receipt, exact one durable outcome after commit, unchanged executing/admission/logical ID/fingerprint plus indeterminate_external_outcome before Knora finalization, provider-outcome-not-found versus closed-rejection persistence, two-variant recovery seed and absence of all #78 behavior.

Temporary-authority approved-state versus material-mismatch stale/invalidated before/after snapshots, exact public discriminated allowlist and forbidden-field matrices for every result, complete expiry-fenced PostgreSQL snapshots, full audit reconstruction, exact subject SHA and all governed verification totals/exits.

prior_findings.problem: V7 collapsed three post-admission fault locations to a zero-or-one provider oracle and did not require unchanged Knora execution state and typed indeterminate projection per branch.
prior_findings.required_change: Require zero ledger/effect before gateway and before SQLite commit, exactly one durable replayable outcome after SQLite commit, and unchanged executing/admission/logical ID/fingerprint plus indeterminate_external_outcome in every not-yet-finalized branch.

prior_findings.problem: V7 proved persistence and provider recomputation but not the original independent server computation or caller non-influence over either identity.
prior_findings.required_change: Recompute from authoritative normalized inputs, compare every generation-1 boundary, and prove writable callers cannot supply or influence logical ID or fingerprint.

prior_findings.problem: V7 did not observe approved preservation after temporary authority denial or durable stale/invalidation after every material compatibility mismatch.
prior_findings.required_change: Assert exact before/after proposal and approval state for temporary denial and each capability/binding/policy/reference mismatch, including mandatory new proposal and approval.

prior_findings.problem: V7 mapped application/HTTP results without an exact public allowlist or forbidden-field oracle for every result variant.
prior_findings.required_change: Compare complete application and decoded HTTP projections to exact variant allowlists and reject all raw provider/routing, admission/envelope/MAC, fingerprint, authority, key/signing, credential/secret and private fields.
